headline: Mid-America Apartment (MAA) Posts Massive Earnings Beat While Revenue Slightly Misses Estimates
summary: Mid-America Apartment Communities (MAA) posted a massive Q2 earnings beat but a slight revenue miss, leaving shares flat. Sun Belt headwinds and no guidance temper enthusiasm.
